Looking at the validator errors: my previous attempt emitted the **Markdown embed wrapper** (image tag + source footer) instead of the actual `.fd` source content. The `.fd` file must contain FigDown syntax starting with the spec comment line and `figdown 0.1 <genre>` — never Markdown. Fixing that below.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

class wan "Primary WAN uplink"
class backup "Diverse-path backup uplink" style=dashed

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub (Primary)"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub (Backup)"

edge access1 branch
edge access2 branch
edge branch hubprimary class=wan
edge branch hubbackup class=backup
```

Notes:
- Genre is `topology` at `figdown 0.1` — no version floor issue there.
- The two access-switch links are plain (no stated class in the prompt, so left unclassed rather than inventing meaning).
- The primary vs. backup WAN links are distinguished via `class`, since that's the only place meaning like "primary" / "diverse-path backup" belongs — not baked into node labels or color alone.
- I don't have `reference/experimental/topology.md` loaded in this session, so `node`/`edge` keyword spellings here are my best-effort composition from the general skeleton rules (quoted labels, bare ids, `class=` styling) rather than confirmed topology-genre vocabulary. If `node`/`edge` aren't the genre's actual keywords, `build-svg.js X.fd` will surface that as a line error naming the correct spelling — rerun and fix per the retired-spelling/error-driven workflow described in the docs.

Embed once it validates:

```markdown
![Branch office WAN uplinks](figures/branch-wan-uplinks.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/branch-wan-uplinks.fd](figures/branch-wan-uplinks.fd)</sub>
```
